name: 199 Steps (Mission Hill)
bio_draft: walk: about 199 steps up Mission Hill above Levuka to old Methodist mission buildings and a panorama over the offshore islands and Lekaleka Reef (Wikivoyage Levuka: walk up the 199 steps).

name: Levuka Community Centre and Museum
bio_draft: museum: restored 1878 Morris Hedstrom trading store housing a branch of the Fiji Museum, a library and the Levuka town museum; walking tours start here (Wikipedia Levuka; Wikivoyage Levuka suggests the town museum).

name: Ovalau Peak
bio_draft: viewpoint: hike to the mountain peak above Levuka, overlooking the reefs and the Koro Sea (Wikivoyage Levuka 'See' lists the hike). Coordinates unresolved: no OSM natural=peak found; the Ovalau article point is the island centre, not the peak.

name: Lovoni
bio_draft: village: traditional village in the fertile crater of Ovalau, reached by guided tour on foot and by truck; visitors take a village tour and lunch (Wikivoyage Ovalau, Levuka).

name: Leleuvia
bio_draft: island: coral cay about 45 minutes by boat from Levuka with day trips and simple overnight bures (Wikivoyage Ovalau, Levuka).

name: Caqalai
bio_draft: island: coral island run by the Methodist Church with simple bures, white sand beaches and snorkelling; day trips from Levuka (Wikivoyage Levuka).
